subject.title: fix(message): ignore populated location on text sends

question: Should `normalizeMessageActionRequest` be accepted as a stable public Channel Plugin SDK contract for channel-owned pre-dispatch rewriting, or should this Telegram repair use a narrower seam?
rationale: The code is a credible delivery repair, but choosing a new public plugin contract and its long-term compatibility obligation requires repository-owner intent rather than contributor-side validation.

options.title: Approve the public normalization hook
options.body: Accept the hook as the supported channel-owned normalization seam and document its ordering, authorization, and compatibility contract.

options.title: Require a narrower seam
options.body: Keep the repair local or introduce a narrower owner-approved interface if general pre-dispatch rewriting is not a supported Plugin SDK capability.

recommendation.title: Approve the public normalization hook
recommendation.body: Accept the hook as the supported channel-owned normalization seam and document its ordering, authorization, and compatibility contract.

likelyOwner.reason: Likely routing point for the unresolved public Plugin SDK and channel-boundary decision.
